Gantry keyboard jog

Connect each board, then enable keyboard jogging. Hold ← / → for X and ↓ / ↑ for Y. Release to stop. Space or Escape stops both axes. One direction at a time.

No homing or travel limits. Watch the gantry and stay clear of the ends. Direction depends on motor wiring. These are independent short moves, not coordinated XY trajectories. Coils release when stopped.
